newsitem.title: USA: Matav to acquire interest in R.P. Telkom.
newsitem.headline: Matav to acquire interest in R.P. Telkom.

text.p: Matav Cable Systems Media Ltd said Wednesday it has signed a share purchase agreement with Trefoil Capital Investors and Shamrock Holdings Inc to acquire about 11.8 percent of the outstanding shares of R.P. Telekom SA at a price of $17.50 per share, or a total of about $17 million.

Matav said it has also agreed to invest additional amounts, under certain conditions, in R.P. to guarantee obligations of R.P. toward third parties. These obligations are estimated at about $29 million, approximately half of which are for guarantees.
This transaction supersedes an agreement previously reported on September 30 and is expected to close on or before May 31.

R.P., which is owned by a group of American, Israeli, and Polish investors, holds licenses to build telecommunications systems, including telephony systems, in areas of Poland covering over 10 million residents. It also holds a license to operate radio trunking services throughout Poland.
Matav is a leading operator and provider of broadband cable TV services in Israel.
